Barriers can be minimized but they can not be completely removed from the
process of Communication.
Discuss the Intrapersonal Barriers in the light of the above statement and also
suggest remedies to overcome them.
Ethics is the backbone of any Communication process and without its presence,
Communication becomes superficial and a liability.
Do you agree or disagree with the given statement? Give suitable reasons for
your answer.
Kinesics is more powerful than words.
What is your opinion about the above statement? Justify your answer in the
light of the sub-types/parts of Kinesics and give relevant examples to explain
each one of them.
Speech is silver and silence is Gold.
What is meant by the above idiom? Elaborate with reference to Listening skills.
Why is understanding and following the Do’s and Don’ts of Listening so important
in the contemporary times?
Are Group Discussions merely a showcase of good Communication Skills? What
are the other skills/ abilities required to participate effectively in GDs? Discuss
with suitable examples.
What is the difference between Resume Writing and Resume building?
Assuming that you are a second year B. Tech student, draft a suitable resume to
be submitted for an exciting Internship opportunity at your dream company.
Invent the necessary details.
Write five paragraphs of four sentences each on the topic,
My first Semester at IGDTUW keeping in mind the nuances of effective
paragraph writing.
Underline the Topic Sentence and Conclusion sentence in each paragraph.
a) Assuming that you are the Library In-charge at IGDTUW, draft a letter of
Enquiry for Sales Manager, Pearson Publishing House requesting
him/her to share the latest catalogue of Communication skills Books.
Invent the necessary details.
b) Draft a suitable email reply to the above. Catalogue.PDF can be shared
as an attachment with the reply. You can invent details if required.
